parsed.public_message: Orange and Blue stay allies. White will not dive the elephants or the archer ball. If Green is still the intact stack on the north rim, that stack decides t=800. I only strike a broken, isolated unit.

private_messages.Claude: Pact holds. I will not attack your javelineer. One hero at 75% dies to the elephant pack, and a dead Alexander scores zero. I am moving up the west rim to watch, and I will only hit a lone wounded unit.
private_messages.Gemini: Ally holds. I am not charging your elephants or cavalry. Keep pressure on Green's archers on the north rim. If they break, I cut stragglers from the west. Do not turn your cavalry onto me.
private_messages.GPT: If you are setting White neutral, do it. I am not walking into the archers this turn. Shooting me still leaves Blue's value on the field; point your shots at whatever actually reaches you.

parsed.notes_to_self: T22 t725. Alex 75% (575,593)->move (579,683) standground. r~75, ~85m from GPT last (656,718). Ring fixed 90; stay r<=80. Saw Gemini at 73m on T21 and cannot see those spots now, so they moved; Gemini says eles+cav went N onto GPT. Only visible: Claude elite jav 100% (630,591), ally, do not touch. Diplo ally/ally/enemy so the peace-skip cannot jump to t=800. Value 375 if HP-scaled, else 500 flat; either way death is 0. T775: attack only a lone wounded hero or <=2 isolated units within ~45m with no ele/cav/archer ball; if archers close under 65m, retreat SW to (575,600); if Claude gives pact-break notice, run opposite. Never center, never r>85, never chase the ball.
parsed.explanation: Alexander is the last white unit, so he cannot trade into elephants or eight archers. He steps up the west side of the ring, about 85 m from Green's last position and still 15 m inside the fire, to see who is left standing. The Orange javelineer is left alone, and only an already broken, isolated unit is worth a strike.
